title: Private key material
recommendation: Remove the key from the tree and from git history, then rotate it. Load replacement keys from a secret store at runtime.

title: AWS access key id
recommendation: Disable the key in AWS, create a replacement outside the repository, and purge the old value from git history.

title: GitHub token
recommendation: Revoke the token, remove it from history, and store a replacement in the CI secret store.

title: Slack token
recommendation: Rotate the Slack credential and keep the new value in a secret store.

title: Google API key
recommendation: Restrict the key by HTTP referrer and API, rotate it if it was unrestricted, and inject it at build time from a secret store.

title: Stripe live secret key
recommendation: Roll the Stripe key and keep the replacement in a secret store.

title: Database connection string with a password
recommendation: Rotate the database password. Store the connection string in a secret store and use a least-privilege account.

title: Azure storage account key
recommendation: Rotate the storage key and move the connection string out of source.

title: npm token
recommendation: Revoke the npm token and authenticate the CLI with a short-lived replacement.

title: JSON Web Token
recommendation: Remove the token from source. Tokens belong in a secret store or a short-lived client session, not in the repository.

title: Hardcoded credential assignment
recommendation: Replace the literal with an environment variable or secret-store lookup, and rotate the exposed value.
